engine_boundaries: Only current_exact/current-scope-limited providers are eligible for the Phase174 diagnosis engine.
Hard ineligibility is shown only when the provider record explicitly says the contract type cannot MNP.
not_assumed/unknown eligibility produces a verification result, not a denial.
MNP One-Stop and reservation-number flows remain separate.
Issue timing is informational and is not treated as a failure until the provider's published window has passed.
Real-account observations are displayed separately from official provider rules.
The engine does not infer account-specific status that the user did not select.
